note: The gold strata are filled by a sequential walk over a seeded random permutation of the gold-pool candidate list, fetching filings on demand and classifying them with the frozen passes; every pass-1 positive is offered to stratum P first, so P is a simple random sample of all pass-1 positives. This is equivalent to sampling from the fully classified universe and avoids waiting for the complete 2013-2017 download. Pass agreement is reported on the filings fetched at build time and recomputed when the download completes. Obvious negatives = both passes non-primary, not UNCLASSIFIED, pass-1 margin >= the median margin of such filings in the fetched corpus.
